# THIRD_PARTY Component
set(THIRD_PARTY_SOURCES
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/*.c
)
set(THIRD_PARTY_HEADERS
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/inc/*.h
)
set(THIRD_PARTY_SOURCES ${THIRD_PARTY_SOURCES} PARENT_SCOPE)
set(THIRD_PARTY_HEADERS ${THIRD_PARTY_HEADERS} PARENT_SCOPE)
set(THIRD_PARTY_INCLUDE_DIRS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/inc PARENT_SCOPE)
